arguments.text: 8000 m, out-and-back 1250 m legs. Let the hard start settle by ~3 min, then hold near pod sustainable power (cp_shaft ~162 W, check calibration against legs). Keep pod reserve above ~30% until 2000 m left, then spend it; finish cue at ~600 m left. Watch for incidents (rudder weed, radio course change, drift). Compare same-direction legs to separate current from fatigue.
